latest_cos_commentary.headline: Xenia is a venture-backed ($12M Series A) frontline operations app for multi-location restaurant and retail brands, covering checklists, inspections, temperature monitoring, and task management, with named customers including Slim Chickens, Zaxby's, and Dave's Hot Chicken.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes with Genius's back_office operations tooling (task management, compliance, temperature monitoring); no overlap with core pos or payments.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Actively growing off a recent Series A raise with multiple named QSR chain customers, indicating momentum in the frontline-ops software category.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Position as an operations/compliance point solution that a prospect may run alongside any POS, including Genius; relevant when the conversation is about checklists/food-safety/temperature monitoring rather than transactions.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Leadership and pricing were not verified in this pass; funding round date/investor unconfirmed.

verification_needed: Series A date and lead investor (amount only was confirmed)
